scripts.build:cloudflare: node ../../scripts/deploy/ensure-landing-astro-manifest-injection.mjs && DOCITA_CLOUDFLARE=1 turbo build --filter=@workspace/ui && DOCITA_CLOUDFLARE=1 node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && DOCITA_CLOUDFLARE=1 astro build
scripts.preview:cloudflare: DOCITA_CLOUDFLARE=1 node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && DOCITA_CLOUDFLARE=1 astro build && printf "_worker.js\n" > dist/.assetsignore && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: DOCITA_CLOUDFLARE=1 node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && DOCITA_CLOUDFLARE=1 astro build && printf "_worker.js\n" > dist/.assetsignore && wrangler deploy
scripts.audit:accessibility: env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 playwright test e2e/accessibility.spec.ts
scripts.test:critical-flows: env -u NO_COLOR FORCE_COLOR=0 playwright test e2e/critical-flows.spec.ts
